Subject: ACME - MAP: legal redlines & MSA/DPA/SLA owners

Hi Sarah —

Great conversation earlier — thanks to you and your team for the time. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_draft_v1.docx) with the milestones we discussed. I wanted to call out the legal milestone specifically so we can lock owners and SLAs:

- Milestone: Finalize MSA/DPA/SLA redlines
  - Owner (commercial/contractual comments): Acme Legal (please track commercial comments in the doc)
  - Owner (MSA/DPA/SLA edits & negotiation): Redwood Legal (Aditya Rao)
  - Proposed turnaround: Acme initial redlines = 3 business days after receipt; Redwood first-pass counter = 2 business days; final sign + DocuSign = target 5 business days after last substantive edit
  - Dependencies: SOC 2 Type II report, Data Processing Addendum, IP annex (if any), inbound procurement PO steps

Target close date for the overall MAP: 2027-05-15 (we can update if your legal timelines push this out).

Can you confirm your legal review SLA and whether Acme will provide a redline (tracked changes) or a list of asks? Once we have your redline, Redwood legal will prioritize and we can commit to the counter SLA.

Attached: ACME_MAP_draft_v1.docx (MAP), placeholder for SOC2 link in the MAP.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending the MAP and for the clear summary. Our legal team will take a first pass and provide track-changes redline. A few notes from our side:

- We typically target 4 business days for initial review on strategic suppliers (legal workload permitting).
- Can Redwood commit to a 5 business-day response window to our redline for the MSA/DPA? Our procurement requires a predictable cadence.
- Dependencies: please include the SOC2 Type II report (or link) and a brief data retention schedule in the DPA. Also confirm whether Redwood will accept an IP annex or needs specific language.

I attached a short note with our redline priorities to help speed review (legal_redlines_notes.pdf). We aim to move quickly but want the review SLAs to be clear.

Thanks —
Sarah

Subject: Re: ACME - MAP: legal redlines & MSA/DPA/SLA owners

Sarah —

Appreciate the note and the priorities doc. To align expectations on our side:

- Redwood legal will own the MSA/DPA edits and negotiate the technical SLA language. Aditya Rao will be the point of contact.
- Proposed Redwood SLAs (internal commitment):
  - First-pass counter (after receiving Acme redline): 2 business days
  - Minor clarifications / email responses: 1 business day
  - DPA/privacy deep review (if required): 3 business days
  - Technical SLA deep review (if new metrics requested): up to 4 business days and may require input from infra/eng (we'll identify dependencies in the MAP)

Updated MAP milestone summary (high-level):
- Acme: Provide redlined MSA/DPA (owner: Acme Legal) — due: 2027-04-15
- Redwood Legal (Aditya): Provide first-pass counter — due: 2 business days after receipt
- Security/Compliance: Provide SOC2 artifacts — due: 3 business days after request
- Procurement/PO: Acme procurement to provide PO info — due: TBD

If any SLA exceptions are needed (e.g., longer SLA review for custom SLA metrics), we'll elevate to sales leadership (Rafael) to align on credits/timing.

Attaching a simple milestone table for the MAP (MAP_Milestones_Table.xlsx). Please confirm the Acme due date for the initial redline so we can lock final target close.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa / Rafael —

I'll take ownership on the Redwood side for the MSA/DPA/SLA negotiation. Quick plan:

- Once we receive Acme's redline (tracked changes), Redwood Legal will:
  1) Provide a first-pass redline on the MSA within 2 business days.
  2) Conduct a DPA/privacy review (including data retention schedule) within 3 business days.
  3) Review/align SLA metrics and escalation clauses within 4 business days; if engineering input is needed, I'll loop infra and confirm timelines.

If Acme's initial review window is 4 business days, and they deliver by 2027-04-15 as discussed, our current plan supports keeping the MAP target close date of 2027-05-15. If we see any substantive IP or security exceptions, I'll flag immediately and Rafael can escalate.

Please send the redlined document to legal@redwood.ai and I'll prioritize intake.

Thanks —
